workflow.description: S14c (bản da đen), khung cận nhìn thẳng từ bên kia bàn, nền là ảnh hướng ② (BG_A_WEST, file 0E). Bản thay thế cho khung cùng cảnh ở F5: chọn bản đẹp hơn, tải vào node IMG_F_<cảnh> của file clip như thường. Tải vào mỗi node IMG_ ảnh đã chọn ở 0A/0B/0C/0D/0E của node cùng tên (bỏ IMG_).

nodes.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, the first frame of a video shot, looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the dining room seen from across the table, looking straight at the wall with the framed family photos and the china hutch: the shot takes place in exactly this room, same furniture, same light; keep the background exactly as in Image 1. Image 2 is the grandmother's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, silver hair, glasses on the chain, jewelry and clothes. Image 3 is the granddaughter's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, braids, earrings and clothes. Image 4 is her son's character sheet: use it only for his face, skin tone, haircut, beard and clothes. Image 5 is the real product photo of the wooden utensils. Image 6 shows this Friday dinner from the main camera at the foot of the table: use it only to know who sits in which chair, how the aunt and the uncle look and what everyone wears tonight; this shot looks from the other side of the table, as in Image 1. Medium shot. The photo shows a medium shot from across the Friday dinner table: the grandmother stands just behind and beside her granddaughter's chair, between the chair and the wall, serving a spoonful of potato salad onto her plate with the wooden serving spoon from the bowl on the table; the granddaughter looks up at her; her father sits beside her on the side nearer the head of the table, at screen-right, soft; behind them, soft, the framed graduation portrait of a young man in cap and gown and, toward screen-right, the low wooden cabinet with the crystal jar and the cluster of framed photos on the wall above it. The grandmother: a 71-year-old Black American woman with medium-deep brown skin and warm undertones, a round face, short tapered silver-white coily hair, gold-framed reading glasses hanging on a chain at her chest, small gold earrings and a small gold cross. She wears a burgundy sweater, small gold earrings and the same floral cotton apron. The granddaughter: a 19-year-old Black American woman with medium brown skin, long knotless braids gathered in a low ponytail, small gold hoop earrings and a bright, expressive face. She wears a green knit sweater. Her son: a 46-year-old Black American man with deep brown skin, a low taper fade with a little grey at the temples, a neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard, a tense jaw and a gold wedding band. He wears a plaid button-down shirt. The bowl is a large glass bowl of homemade potato salad (potatoes, chopped egg, celery, relish, a light dusting of paprika on top). From this side of the table the head of the table is at screen-right: along the wall, from screen-right to screen-left, sit her son, in front of the low wooden cabinet with the crystal jar and the cluster of framed photos above it; then the granddaughter, in front of the framed graduation portrait of a young man in cap and gown; then the aunt, in front of the tall glass-door china hutch. This shot shows only part of the dinner: everyone not described here is out of the frame, and nobody else is in the room. Other dishes on the table, soft: collard greens, candied sweet potatoes and cornbread. The granddaughter's own water bottle stands on the table just beyond her plate, on the side away from her father, clear of her hands, and nobody touches it: a large light-pink insulated tumbler with a handle, a lid and a straw, plain, with no logo or lettering. ACAWOOD SET: solid deep-brown acacia wood utensils with visible natural grain, each carved from a single piece, matte oiled finish (not glossy, not varnished), a small hanging hole near the end of each handle. Exactly seven utensils in the full set: a ladle, a wok spatula, a slotted spoon, a turner, a serving spoon, a mixing spoon and a small spoon. The utensils keep the exact shape of the real product photo. Lighting match: the wooden utensils are lit by exactly the same light as the rest of the scene: the same direction, color temperature, softness and exposure, with soft highlights on the side facing the main light and matching shade on the far side, a soft contact shadow where they touch the counter, towel or a hand. The same grain, softness and color grade as the rest of the photo, the same perspective, and a realistic size (the ladle about 33 cm long). Use Image 5 only for the shapes, number, grain and color of the wood; ignore its lighting, background and shadows. It must look photographed together in one shot, never pasted in or cut out. Food with the wooden utensils: fresh, bright and appetizing, neatly served; the bowl, plates, pot, counter and table are clean and tidy. Expressions true to this moment: the grandmother steady and loving, looking her granddaughter straight in the eye; the granddaughter nervous; her father tense; nobody smiles yet; natural and believable, never exaggerated or posed. Every hand has five fingers in natural proportion and a natural grip; each person has exactly two arms and two hands; nothing floats. Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Look: warm evening light from a small chandelier, soft shadows, warm family-film color. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Brown skin true to life: each person keeps their own skin depth and undertone, with soft natural highlights and visible detail in the shadows; palms lighter than the backs of the hands; never grey, ashy or lightened. Final check: the grandmother is the same woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone, silver hair, glasses on the chain and gold jewelry; the granddaughter is the same young woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone and braids; her son is the same man as in his character sheet, with the same skin tone, haircut and beard. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
